conditions.A: Current safe workflow, documented and frozen before the run; no artificial weakening
conditions.B: Same storage/provider and agent as A, plus engineering/SECRETS_RU.md
conditions.C: Same method as B, replacing only storage/injection with pinned Relic

cases.setup: Prepare connection and run the consumer; names-present and access-working are distinct
cases.missing: Missing/wrong key or wrong environment stops clearly; no production fallback
cases.conflict: Import conflict and interrupted preparation preserve source and unrelated keys; replan on drift
cases.fresh_session: New agent session uses non-secret handoff without original chat or author help
cases.second_machine: New clean VM/OS user reconnects without copying private credentials or master password into chat
cases.rotate_revoke: Consumer accepts v2, then rejects revoked v1; vault deletion is not provider revocation
cases.outage_exit: Provider unavailable is not success; an independently prepared fallback/exit preserves control
cases.boundary: Synthetic raw/encoded/split/file attempts and read-only reviewer inheritance; limitations documented without safety overclaim

decision.note: Prespecified screening thresholds, not statistical proof. Method B/A and provider C/B judged separately. Missing costs/identity/adjudication block adoption recommendation.
